    Concrete finite posets and forbidden configurations #

    For the configurations excluded by Lemma 8.8 in Part III (four-point crowns, four-leaf stars, the Euclidean trees of the table after lem:dimension-infinity): a poset on Fin n given by a Boolean table (Pos), whose axioms, cover relation, uniqueness of lower covers and dimension count are checked by decide. forbidden transfers the conclusion along an order isomorphism, for the poset and its dual.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
